title: DynaMag: COMET route-conditioned control for magnetic carrier navigation
description: Simulation code, frozen benchmark manifests and trial-level results for the article "COMET: Route-Conditioned Control for Safe Magnetic Carrier Navigation in Patient-Derived Vascular Models" (submitted to Micromachines). DynaMag simulates a nine-coil electromagnetic array steering a 500 um magnetic carrier through patient-derived vessel networks from the Vascular Model Repository, with gravity, finite-Reynolds drag, analytical and steady CFD flow, actuator limits and patient positioning, and compares the COMET controller with nonlinear MPC and other baselines on a 75-case benchmark.
